sloka: त्राहि माम् अद्य काकुत्स्थ लक्ष्मण इति वरांगना ।सु संत्रस्ता समाक्रंदत् शृण्वताम् तु यथा अन्तिके ॥३-५२-५॥
transliteration: trāhi mām adya kākutstha lakṣmaṇa iti varāṁganā ।su saṁtrastā samākraṁdat śṛṇvatām tu yathā antike ॥3-52-5॥

translations.english: Terribly frightened, the beautiful lady (Sita) cried bitterly, 'O Rama, O Lakshmana, save me', as if they were close by and were listening to her.
